items.question: Should drone, missile and nuke strikes use up the attacker's supply, and should successful ones reduce the defender's morale?
Should new provinces start with 0 population, with the player choosing how much population to move into them from their existing provinces?
Should population growth go back to being calculated per province (each province with its own growth and limits) instead of the current nation-wide system?
Should the game show why unrest is rising or falling, and show unemployed people and open jobs, in the province view?
Should resource amount fields (market orders etc.) accept suffixes like k, m, kt so large amounts are easier to type?
Should electricity become a storable resource (batteries, hourly surplus/deficit, tradable power) instead of the current simple power check?
Should the coalition bank get a separate "Donate" deposit button that adds resources to the coalition bank instead of the player's personal balance?
Should the game UI be reorganised around a sidebar (hidden behind a button on mobile) with grouped dropdown sections, and an optional resources dropdown in the top bar?
Should your own open orders be shown inside the main Market offer list, next to other players' orders (in addition to the Your Orders tab)?
Should your own trades be shown in the market trade list (to avoid duplicate offers), with an option to edit active trades' prices and quantities?
Should a mass delete (sell off) buildings button be added so you can remove a building type across all your provinces at once, like Mass Purchase in reverse?
Should the loan fee above 70% of the loan limit be a 20% fee on only the portion above 70%, instead of the current 15% fee on the whole loan?
add i for information on building cards
Higher education pops should be able to substitute lower education ones
Separate personal balances from bank balances.
